categories.infrastructure: Cloud storage, media relay, hosting, and deploy pipelines
categories.ui-quality: Frontend visual hierarchy, responsive layout, and collaborative interaction standards

standards.name: Spoke & Wheel Single Source of Truth
standards.description: Hub documents contain only indices (max 150 lines). Spoke documents own detailed specifications and declare parent hub in frontmatter.

standards.name: Governance Artifact Wiring Completeness
standards.description: All new workflows, skills, and patterns must be wired into skill-router.yaml and CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md.

standards.name: 4-Phase Problem-Solving Discipline
standards.description: Strict adherence to Ground Truth -> Research Benchmarks -> Objective Rules -> Evidence-Based Execution.

standards.name: Modular Component Architecture & SDCA Standard
standards.description: Zero monolithic UI scripts. No web module or HTML assembler may exceed 500 lines or embed raw monolithic HTML/CSS templates inline. All UI features must follow the Static Decoupled Component Assembler (SDCA) directory structure and consume centralized primitives from ui_primitives/.

standards.name: Tri-Modal Visual Intake & Collaborative Deep-Link Sharing Standard
standards.description: Visual procurement and decor modules must provide showroom photo ingestion, Pinterest CDN normalization, multi-option container pods, and URL deep-linking with active option state (?item=X&option=Y).

standards.name: Mandatory Ticket Registration & Phased Planning Gate
standards.description: Any multi-directional, multi-phased (≥2 phases), or multi-surface development work must register an enhancement ticket in enhancement-notes/ and define a sequential phased DoD matrix before implementation or plan creation begins.

standards.name: Universal Canonical Planning Engine & Cross-Repo SAP Synchronization
standards.description: All multi-step planning is governed by the single canonical SAP-delimited planning engine in writing-plans/SKILL.md, enforcing 4-PPSD, Gate 0 ticket checks, phased DoD v1.7 matrices, 5-step TDD tasks, binary validation gates, and plan hard-stops.

standards.name: Universal Sheet-Drive Media Relay & Real-Time Audit Ledger Standard
standards.description: Cross-repo zero-billing media storage standard leveraging Google Apps Script text/plain Simple POST relay, client-side 2K offscreen Canvas budgeting, two-tier Google Sheet routing and 12-dimension audit ledger, dynamic subfolder auto-provisioning with 10-minute CacheService TTL, and universal 2K UserContent CDN resolution.

standards.name: Multi-Module Google Drive Hierarchy & Mandatory Module Onboarding Standard
standards.description: Cross-module storage hierarchy partitioning media into distinct subfolders per operational module (Shopping, Decor, Liturgy, Finance, Operations) and enforcing the Module Onboarding Standard (INV-MODULE-UPLOAD-INTAKE-001) with automated sheet self-provisioning (INV-RELAY-AUTO-HEAL-006).
